address: 16 Albemarle Street, Mayfair, London, W1S 4HW, United Kingdom
bio: From the Mayfair postcode to the impressive marble counter, there is a luxury feel to this first international venture from French celebrity chef Cyril Lignac. Sharing a name with its pre-cursor in Saint-Germain, it also mirrors that restaurant's Japanese-influenced approach – expect maki, sashimi and miso black cod. For the terrific desserts, you travel back to France for classics like mille-feuille, tarte fine and profiteroles....
